summary: Unsupported but structurally valid plugin host majors now pass manifest shape validation and are refused by the common lifecycle funnel with HostVersionUnservedError. One contract-owned served-major tuple drives both lifecycle admission and orb.host runtime negotiation.

behavior.structural_manifest: hostVersion accepts positive integers; zero, fractional, and string values remain schema failures
behavior.lifecycle: parseBundle throws HostVersionUnservedError with code plugin_host_version_unserved plus requested and served data when a parsed major is absent from PLUGIN_HOST_VERSIONS
behavior.install: refuses before CAS or plugin-row persistence
behavior.upgrade: refuses before replacing the stored bundle or installed version
behavior.runtime: orb.host uses the same PLUGIN_HOST_VERSIONS tuple and retains the guest-visible HostVersionError
behavior.transport: HostVersionUnservedError extends DomainOperationError, so the existing tRPC mapper emits BAD_REQUEST and data.reason=plugin_host_version_unserved
